question_text: Explain the time complexity of the Merge Sort algorithm using the Master Theorem.
subject: Computer Science & Engineering
model_answer: Merge sort divides an array of size n into two subarrays of size n/2. The recurrence is T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n). By Master Theorem, case 2 applies giving Theta(n log n).
evaluation_rubric: 5 marks total: 2 for recurrence, 2 for Master theorem steps, 1 for final O(n log n)
